2. The learned Public Prosecutor takes notice for 1 st and 2nd respondents.
Food Safety and Standards Authorities of India is suo motu impleaded as the additional 3rd respondent.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authorities of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. The petitioner is directed to serve a copy of this Crl.M.C. to the Standing Counsel for Food Safety and Standard Authorities of India.
Show the name of the Standing Counsel in the cause list.
4. This Crl.M.C. is filed challenging the prosecution initiated against the petitioners under the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

The main contention put forward by the petitioner is that, the sample was tested in a laboratory which is not having recognition and accreditation as contemplated under Section 43 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

sentences.text: 5. On perusal of the records, I find a prima facie case in favour of the petitioner.
Therefore, there shall be an interim order staying all further proceedings in S.T. No.268/2020 before the Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court-I, Manjeri, for a period of three months.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court-I, Manjeri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 6. It is pointed out by the learned Additional DGP that, even though the Act came into force in the year 2006, even now, Food Authority has not notified any Food Laboratories or Research Institutions in Kerala for the purpose of compliance of Section 43 of the Act.

I am of the view that,
the failure in granting accreditation and recognition as contemplated under Section 43 of the Act,
would cause serious prejudice to the prosecuting agencies in enforcing the provisions of Food Safety Act and thus purpose of the Act will get defeated.
7.

Therefore, the respondents are directed to file a statement as to the steps so far taken for getting the laboratories and research institutions in the State accredited and recognised in tune with Section 43 of the Act and also the stages of the same.
In case, no steps have been taken so far urgent measures in this regard has to be taken.
The Statement in this regard shall be submitted within a period of one month from today.
Post after one month.

Sd/-
ZIYAD RAHMAN A.A. JUDGE ncd/29.08.2022 29-08-2022 /True Copy/
